INTROPara-1: Vishwakarma Design Studio is a multidisciplinary design studio based out of Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Started in 1992 by Karthikeyan Padmanabhan and Ruckmini Karthikeyan, partners in the business and in life. Vishwakarma Design Studio is the creative expression of the architect and product designers
INTROPara-2: Our story is a humble one that begins with two young architects discovering their niche in Coimbatore. Meeting at their place of work, Karthikeyan and Ruckmini started their business, Karthik and Karthik, an architectural firm, along with another partner, and Turya Designs, a product and design practice, in 1995.
SOUL: The soul of our design lies in light and nature.
SOUL-PARA: Vishwakarma is known for its unique creative expression and flair for experimenting with unique structures and curves, as well as applying materiality and textures to its design aesthetic. The studio has undertaken a wide range of projects, including residences, commercial spaces, religious spaces, factories, and niche projects. Vishwakarma has carved a name for its wholistic approach to design, specializing in creating the architecture, interior, and furniture design of spaces.
SOUL-PARA2: Karthikeyan, the principal architect and founder, has worked on over 500 projects throughout his career, from inception and ideation to completion. We are pioneers in incorporating copper, tiles, and hand-etched glass into our furniture, resulting in stunning works of art that are unique, statement pieces. The couple runs their architectural and design practice with a small and dedicated team of designers, craftsmen, artists, and staff who are all invested, passionate, and have a penchant for incredible ideas and a dedication to perfecting their craft. With our vast expertise gained over time, we are confidently marching towards our avowed goal of attaining undisputed leadership in this demanding field.
VISHWA-NUMBER-PARA: Since 1995, we have implemented more than 500 projects in different parts of the country, across a varied typology and style of spaces
karthikeyan-description-1: Karthikeyan Padmanabhan is the founding architect at Vishwakarma Design Studio. After completing his bachelors in Architecture from Manipal Institute of Technology in 1987, he worked as a junior architect at Shankar and Associates. Turya Designs came to life in 1992, in Coimbatore with his wife, Ruckmini which has become Vishwakarma Design Studio today.
karthikeyan-description-2: An old school architect, learning new technology he still values the process of putting pen to paper and this is reflected in his unique and incredible designs.
Ruckmini-quote-1: LEADING A FULFILLINGLIFE IS KEY TO  GROWTH AND ABUNDANCE. BALACING SPIRITUALITY FAMILY, WORK AND INTERNAL GROWTH IS INTEGRAL IN OUR LIVES AND ORGANISATION.
Ruckmini-description-1: Ruckmini Karthikeyan is the cofounder of Vishwakarma design studio and is the management brains behind the studio. She graduated with a bachelors in Architecture from NIT, Trichy in 1986.Trained as an architect but discovered her passion for numbers and took over the reigns as the managing director. She is the brains and numbers person behind the firm and drives the success of the firm and our projects.
shreya-quote-1: CREATIVE EXPRESSION IS THE FOUNDATION OF OUR SOULS. LEAD WITH LOVE AND LIGHT.
shreya-description-1: Shreya Karthikeyan, who is a second gen spatial architect and designer who is a cross disciplinary artist and designer. Her passion and talents are spread across graphic, spatial, literature, sketching , painting and fashion and she combines them in her design practice. She serves as the creative head and practices as an architect as Vishwakarma. Apart from that she also manages creative identities and branding for the firm and for clients.
employee-para: Our team is a passionate group of individuals that are driven and motivated. They are the ones working tirelessly to make our designs and your dreams come alive. We are proud to call them our team and love how they thrive and flourish along with us and we become family. At Vishwakarma Design Studio, we believe in a wholisitic growth  for our employees and their families, and we strive to make it a joyous enviroment that helps them grow.
Service-black-para-1: At Vishwakarma Design Studio, We weave stories through our spaces and designs.
Service-black-para-2: We sail with our clients on unique journies to bring to the life spaces, brands and identities.
Service-the-brand-para: At Vishwakarma Design Studio, We weave stories through our spaces and designs. We sail with our clients on unique journies to bring to the life spaces, brands and identities.
Kayal-para: Kayal is a contemporary event space designed for weddings and intimate gatherings. Blurring the lines between the built and the unbuilt environment, we've designed and created a space that brings in the natural beauty of the areca nut palm grove with our architectural design, resulting in a beautiful space for an event.
Actcall-para: ACT Centre is a commercial space that we designed in 2006.
century-para: Century Apparels is a special project for us, a beautiful factory, workspace and establishment that is architecturally stunning especially for a garment manufacturing platform. The office is strategically located, with stunning art, custom furniture and murals designed by us, showcasing a beautiful key space that hosts buyers, sellers and clients.
century-para2: The founders of Century believe in the holistic wellbeing of their employees and staff, with state of the art quarters that have a flood of natural light and air. The office was also designed with an open space plan to integrate all levels and hierarchies of departments to foster communication and collaboration. This factory is a must visit and hallmarks of our design!
jjmills-para: JJ Mills is an interior office design that we did in 2009, with a touch of our iconic style.
springmount-para: Learning is a key aspect in every child's life, the education we receive sets us up for life, shaping the core of a person outside of their home and family. When we designed Spring Mount School, we wanted to inculcate key aspects of holistic growth in a child that fosters out of the box thinking, and a deep connection to nature which was important to the school management. We designed an elementary school which complemented an existing group of secondary and higher secondary school students.
springmount-para2: The courtyards form the core of the flow of spaces, with the classrooms around reflecting elements of water,earth,sunlight, through materiality and elemental motifs and teaching the students key, crucial aspects through the design. Our favorite feature is the usage of recycled glass soda bottles to design the railing.
egli-para: This office is a contemporary design, with a modern landscaped courtyard serving as the focal point and all other utilities revolving around it. The office inculcates a lot of natural light and ventilation, breaking away from a corporate feel and has our signature handcrafted detailing, which makes it unique.
lnbjewellers-para: This office space is designed for a wholesale jeweller merchant, which is a prominent business in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Nestled in the heart of the city, we designed this for supplier and vendor interactions and a personal cabin space for the client for his personal use and interactions with clients as well. We also included a display space to display the products and the design theme of the entire office is rustic and traditional.
precol-para: This design is the personal office of the Managing Director of the Pricol group, an enterprising group of companies. This served as his personal space for his entrepreneurial pursuits in the restaurateur business and travel industry.
precot-para: This is the corporate office of Precot, a premier spinning mill and textile and manufacturing company based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. This office served as a apex space for their corporate interactions and testing and analysis lab for their yarn.
spmkadri-para: The key word given by the client while designing this office is to step away from the the routine and norm. We managed to pull a twist on the space with handpainted elements, panelling and adding some life to the space.
texmo-para: The office we designed for Texmo is an intimate workspace and creative think tank space for their projects and ventures. Designed to be immersed in nature and a space to step away from the norm to create and ideate.
texmo-para2: The inspiration we drew from is a cabin in the woods.
nalanda-para: The Nalanda conference center is a luxury, wellness space that is designed to host retreats and programs. Nestled under the foothills of Siruvani, this space really opens up to the natural environment, making it a perfect space to rejuvenate.
adams-para: A small bespoke tailor space for the client in Coimbatore. This intimate studio showcases custom murals, detailing such as a bowtie magazine stand as the tailors specialises in suits, and designer mirrors to accentuate the space.
anantaboutique-para: Ananta is a boutique dealing in ethnic wear and traditional clothing in Coimbatore, India.
avatharjewellers-para: Avathar jewellers are a family business dealing in gold jewellery. The showroom we did for them is warm and bright lit, with a very classic interior design.
berlyhouse-para: The Beryl House is a spectrum of green hues, with the natural environment brought inside with the courtyard and lawn, creating a beautiful home. Karthikeyan Padmanabhan, our founder and principal architect created this house with large expansive windows, allowing a ton of natural light, ventilation and a play of the form with openings and elevation to create a beautiful structure.
bharanisilks-para: Bharani silks is a legacy in the saree and pattu business for two generations, based out of Erode, Tamil Nadu. We designed and constructed a retail store fit for their expansive and large retail business, catering to a wide range of clothing and segments. Since it was a large scale business and retail space, we kept the design very simple and professional and still incorporated detailing that distinguishes it from the competitors. The interiors are also customized to highlight the different sections and types of clothing.
chiar-para: This residence is a cozy residential property for a family of three and are all expats working in different countries. They wanted an intimate, well designed and functional house that they could come back to when they visit India and wanted a colorful yet minimalistic interior. We played with the facade of the house, with insertions of light and color, making the house very light. We also infused pops of color in the common areas and had traditional attangudi flooring in the bedrooms to enrichen the space.This house is named aptly Chiaroscuro, a play of color and light.
circularhouse-para: The Circular House is a modern architectural form that is designed in a spiral with a core courtyard informing the circulation and access to the rest of the residence. This courtyard acts as a floodlight of light, cross ventilation and gathering space. Our design practice leans on core principles of our founder and principal architect that are reflected in our projects, including vernacular architecture and natural, localised typologies of design.
colorhouse-para: The Color House, a residence in Chennai, Tamil Nadu was indeed the embodiment of color.  Our brief for the home was to infuse the space with color, to show the joy and color in the lives of the  residents in the home we were creating for them. As designers we get a plethora of clients with unique stories and for the lovely family, we implemented as much color as possible in various forms throughtout the house. Our palette was built around blues and greens, with handpainted furniture, custom gond murals that wraps around the staircase, blue and teal furniture in the dining room and a golden yellow courtyard, with a primary color palette to highlight the custom cut niches.  All our projects lean on natural ventilation  and light, connecting nature and humans, which further accentuate the colors used in the space.
colorhouse-para2: The Color House is a lively intersection of color, art and stories woven through space.
coolcooper-para: Cool Copper is a retail clothing showroom based out of Coimbatore, India.
cottonblossom-para: This residence was designed by us at the earlier stages of our architectural journey, for a textile manufacturer based out of Tiruppur, India, the hub of garment manufacturing and exports.
vadavallidonuts-para: The Donuts is a chain of bakeries and confectioneries based out of Coimbatore, India. This outlet, in Vadavalli has a fun and retro theme, with 3D cupcakes we designed and made hung from the ceiling as a detail to highlight the cafe.
saidonuts-para: The Donuts is a chain of bakeries and confectioneries based out of Coimbatore, India. This outlet, in Sai baba colony, is designed with a colonial theme that is more ornate in style. This outlet is the main kitchen for the chain and is designed with their production kitchen designed for supply for all the outlets in the city.
thudonuts-para: The Donuts is a chain of bakeries and confectioneries based out of Coimbatore, India. This outlet, in Thudiyalur is designed with a tropical theme in mind.
eventdecors-para: The Tree of Life is a wedding stage design that we designed and brought to life for a lovely couple and dear friends for their special day. We customized the backdrop with props such as a wheel wagon, and custom made a brass tree backdrop to represent the beginning of the couples journey. We at Vishwakarma, love everything design, our versatility and penchant for bringing any idea to life, enables us to think out of the box and take up any project.
garmentnook-para: Garment Nook is a retail clothing boutique store designed for a client in Coimbatore with our signature style and interior detailing.
hoe-para: A residence for a family who wanted a farm life and atmosphere, we designed this with a palette of white and earthen tones, with traditional red oxide flooring as used in tamizh housing, chettinad motifs and built in thinai (traditional porch in tamizh culture) as key design elements.
iasiveedu-para: The Isai Veedu is a residence we designed for the renowned singer Sudha Raghunathan, her home a blend of traditional, classical design that is a homage to her illustrious musical career.
ishalife-para: Isha Life is a wellness and recreational centre that we designed in 2010. A holistic approach to wellness, the space encompassed a retail space, spa, gym, massage centre and restaurant serving healthy food. Our signature elements and handcrafted feel throughout the space makes it truly one of a kind.
ishaschool-para: The office we designed for Texmo is an intimate workspace and creative think tank space for their projects and ventures. Designed to be immersed in nature and a space to step away from the norm to create and ideate. The inspiration we drew from is a cabin in the woods.
kotajewellers-para: A pioneer in the jewellery business, the Kota jewellers are a family run business in the jewellery business for the past four generations. We designed their showroom in the heart of the jewellery and commercial district in Coimbatore, where the original traders of the city had settled in, with a modern, well lit store and traditional detailing of warm wood, lighting and handpainted panels.
lighthouse-para: Light house is a residence set in the suburbs of Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. We designed this house for a young couple who were busy entrepreneurs and their sons to create a beautiful house for them to grow together. Aptly named the lighthouse, the residence is punctured with light pockets that illuminate the house naturally and creates a beautiful play with light and texture.
lighthouse-para2: The design language of the house comes from tradition and artistic taste meeting contemporary architecture, where we wanted to create a house that highlighted comfort, luxury and tradition. This is showcased through the house, with pockets of nostalgia and family referred to across the residence. Bespoke custom murals, a gentle palette with muted tones and specific detailing across to reflect the tastes and interests of the members of the household. We played with a limited material board of wood, glass and marble to create the mood for this residence and used custom artwork, sculptures and furniture to accentuate the spaces.
mahapalace-para: Maha Palace Fitness Centre is a gym centre in Tiruppur, India that we designed and built in 2010.
mahilampoo-para: Mahilampoo is an apartment we designed in 2010 and constructed as developers. The apartment is known for the cross ventilation and modern form.
malli-para: This is another apartment we designed and developed in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
mootram-para: The Mootram Veedu, which translates to the Courtyard House in tamil is a stunning residence located in the suburbs of Somanur, Tamil Nadu. The house is rooted in Tamizh tradition and vastu, feng shui adhered principles, with a warm, rich palette, resulting in a beautiful home for the client. We, at Vishwakarma have a signature use of the courtyard as our crux, and an energy point to plan our spaces around. The principal architect and founder, Karthikeyan Padmanabhan believes in the courtyard as a meeting point for the entire family, a gathering space as well as a meeting point for energy flow in the space. The courtyard, a connection to nature, architecturally acts as a flood light and ventilation, with the remaining functions of the home arching from the courtyard.
mootram-para2: The rich, warm palette of coppers, brass and deep reds and earth tones accentuate the traditional detailing and design we envisioned for the residence. We believe in handworked elements and attention to detailing yet keeping the residence as a minimalistic layout for functionality and maintenance. In summary, the Mootram Veedu is a residence that is auspicious, and has a reverence for tradition and function.
mootram2-para: The office we designed for Texmo is an intimate workspace and creative think tank space for their projects and ventures. Designed to be immersed in nature and a space to step away from the norm to create and ideate. The inspiration we drew from is a cabin in the woods.
oculus-para: The Oculus house is a signature style of our principal architect and founder, Karthikeyan Padmanabhan, with his minimalistic style of architecture and fine detailing to accentuate the architectural form. A purist in his style, combined with creativity and craftsmanship makes this house a true architectural marvel.
oculus-para2: The client is a family of four, with a background in lighting design and business wanted a space to grow their family in.
pralochnanew-para: Pralochna apparels is a showroom for textiles and apparels based out of Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Specialsing in handloom and block print textiles and clothes, the brand is a staple in the city.
pralochnaold-para: Pralochna apparels is a showroom for textiles and apparels based out of Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Specialsing in handloom and block print textiles and clothes, the brand is a staple in the city.
purplebay-para: Purple Bay is a sanitary wares showroom located at Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu that deals in luxury sanitwary and bathroom accessories. We designed this space to truly have an immersive, experiential experience for clients to come and see products.
sepiahouse-para: The Sepia house is a warm toned residence that is designed for a family in the suburbs of Coimbatore, India. A palette of beige, browns, and metal tones with handmade doors, furniture and hand painted furniture to accentuate the house.
attangudi-para: The Attangudi Veedu is a traditional residence designed for an entrepreneur and his family in Coimbatore. The house, located in the heart of a residential zone in south of Coimbatore, is worked with traditional detailing such as a temple altar constructed in granite, and pure wood carved furniture and cladding as well as handmade athangudi tiling. The residence is a homage to traditional tamizh architectural style.
soupandsaladaadyar-para: Soup and Salad is a chain of restaurants based out of Chennai, India. The ethos of the chain is rooted in conscious, mindful, healthy eating that compromises of contemporary takes on soups and salads, as the name suggests. We have designed each outlet with an ode to the history and cultural significance of the area in Chennai, with custom detailing and spatial qualities that reflect the unique area. In this restaurant, we opted for a more green, nature inspired detail that is reminiscent of the green streets of Adyar, which retains it quality of a quaint, older neighbourhood of chennai.
soupandsaladttk-para: Soup and Salad is a chain of restaurants based out of Chennai, India. The ethos of the chain is rooted in conscious, mindful, healthy eating that compromises of contemporary takes on soups and salads, as the name suggests. We have designed each outlet with an ode to the history and cultural significance of the area in Chennai, with custom detailing and spatial qualities that reflect the unique area. In this restaurant, we included murals of classical icons and musical elements to enrich the design. TTK road has a significance of traditional carnatic music because of the music academy which hosts the classical music festivals during the margazhali festival.
stackhouse-para: The Stack House is an interesting residence we designed in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu for a young entrepreneur and jeweller. He had a site that was very small in size, sandwiched between a multi-storey building and an empty site on the other side. The buildings across the street were mid level apartment buildings as well. The size of the plot was about 1200 sq ft and we had to design a residence for him as a single user with additions for future family.  With the site constraints, we decided to stack the programs of the space vertically, resulting in an interesting form and flow of spaces. The plan is stacked on top of each other, dividing and grouping the programs based on function and zoning of public to private.
stackhouse-para2: The Stack House is a typology of residence that is unique to the Coimbatore residential landscape. Since we are generous and blessed with more landspace, the houses more often lean towards a horizontal planning and this posed an interesting challenge for us. The design evolved into a 4 storey plan with a semi-basement garage that could house upto four cars and we tucked away all the services and amenities into the garage. The remaining floors were divided into public, semi-public and private zones, from ground floor to the second floor.
summerhouse-para: The Summer House is a space designed to relax and indulge in luxury while reconnecting with ourselves and the people around us. The client, Manoj came to us to design this house around 2020, as a weekend getaway property for his family to whisk away to on the weekends. The client and his family are industrialists who work in the garment and vegan product business with work shuffling them between Coimbatore, Tirupur and Kangayam, three industrial and enterprising cities in the west of Tamil Nadu. Since they have to keep travelling for work between the cities, came to us with a brief of creating a luxury farmhouse. Nestled in a 100 acre property that is lush with foliage, the house is perched amidst a grove of trees, farmland and their garment factory, resulting in beautiful views all around. A cow shed and duck pond are situated close to the property, and the children frolic and spend a large portion of their time there, with the animals and in the farm. There is a miniature version of a hand pump recreated for the kids to experiment and play and get a chance to see how it functions.
summerhouse-para2: The property leans on nature and outside spaces such as the veranda, spa, pool, garden and a play area for the children to shape the flow of spaces and character. Natural sunlight, open courtyards and details run through the house, creating memorable encounters at every turn. The use of a natural and neutral pallete at the Summer House, allows the surrounding landscape and the materials used to shine. The design language of the house comes from nostalgia meeting contemporary architecture, we wanted to create a house that highlighted comfort, luxury and tradition. This is showcased through the house, with personal artefacts and references to the clients background, such as the hand painted veena mounted below a glass ledge, creating a conversational piece. Another highlight is the feature wall, with cow masks and carvings as the clients son has an affinity to cows. The client, Manoj had two important briefs: natural light is key and their affinity towards courtyards. This fit in perfectly with the design language Karthikeyan, the principal architect and founder of Vishwakarma. The property is punctured with courtyards that flood light into the space, with wide walkways and passage ways around the courtyard, and using customized artisanal furniture that complete the space.
terrahouse-para: The Terra House is a rich residence designed in the suburbs of Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu for a family of four who are industrialists and wanted a home that was immersed in nature and a getaway.
treehouse-para: The theme for this residence is the tree of life. All the detailing and designs are inspired by a tree, the source of life.
vasavitemple-para: The Vasavi temple is a temple revered and held in high regard by the Vysya community in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu and this project is an ongoing renovation of the temple structure and interiors with an addition of an community annex, with a mandapam ( wedding hall and venue) as well as rooms and a rooftop dining and intimate event space for the community.

yarnhouse-para: Set amidst the background of the industrial background of textiles, locks and agricultural machinery , Dindigul is a city in the heart of the southern part of Tamil Nadu. Dindigul is an ancient settlement, with many dynasties ruling over millennia, creating a rich history in the city. Set against this background, the Yarn House is a residence we created, weaving a beautiful space for a joint family who are in the spinning and textile business.  This residence is situated in their mill compound, serving as a gathering space for the entire family.
yarnhouse-para2: A spanning lavish home, with 5 bedrooms, a home gym, pool intersected by communal spaces and gathering points all connected to a focal courtyard which floods in natural light throughout the day. The spaces are linked through the design elements, with a contemporary take on traditional motifs and elements.  The principal architect and designer, Karthikeyan Padmanabhan, is a man of few words. His work speaks for itself and the Yarn House is an example of this. The design and spatial quality of the residence is immersed in the details with each room designed in a distinct yet succinct character with natural light,  cross ventilation that brings the residence alive.
